sections.title_hint: The Signal: {the single sharpest change since last coverage}
required: lead with the sharpest change since the prior report, sourced and dated
three-beat: what happened, what it means, implication
state what the consensus read misses
charts: combo_bars_line or series_bars if a ladder moved

sections.title_hint: The Ledger Moves: What Changed and What Did Not
required: every material field change since the prior snapshot, each sourced and tiered
explicitly list load-bearing figures that did NOT change
flag stale facts (decay-class breaches) that could not be refreshed

sections.title_hint: The Thesis Check: Confirmed, Extended, or Contradicted
required: test the standing thesis against the new facts
name each prior named trigger and whether it fired
second-order: who must react, what it confirms or falsifies
charts: ranked_bars for cohort position if it moved

sections.title_hint: The Verdict and the Watch List
required: restate or revise the position explicitly
dated forward hooks: the next three published numbers that matter
the falsifier: which single print would change the answer
full categorized fact sheet with source, date, tier on every row
